limits: Playing-frame exact timestamps remain null; only screenshot player UI whole seconds are transcribed.
Initial duration and batch-end duration differ slightly; the batch record is preserved and neither value identifies a screenshot.
Three displayed samples are different photographs and cannot serve as original/result pairs.
Face blur in the recording cannot support any facial geometry or identity QA.
Extreme example slider values are source-picture configuration, not defaults for PS or other cosplay photographs.
The software version, plugin compatibility and PS2020 replication are not established by these frames.
Actual inverted-subject-mask configuration is now observed; a mask label/thumbnail does not prove precise hair/person-edge coverage or manual refinements.
The PixCake JPG and Lightroom ARW share an identifiable pose, but file conversion, face blur, scales and software rendering preclude a controlled A/B quality conclusion.
Visible Oniric entry controls and explanatory captions do not prove glow generation, amount or threshold.
